scope: Selected source-labelled exchanges from the saved Amelia/Cristina archive (Moxy_Complete_Claude_Handoff_2026-11-03). Each line is one separate message. Cards are markers only: historical captions, prices, availability and bonuses are NOT current product or purchase authority. kind=failure examples show what not to do. Evaluation conversations are kept out of this file.

examples.creator: cristina
examples.lesson: Answer unavailable requests directly; describe a specific alternative only if it exists in CURRENT eligible inventory. Historical product availability is not current authority. The invitation should identify an actual selected product.
